kind: FIXED RESEARCH HYPOTHESES; NOT ACTIVE TRADING
maximum_stop_distance: .75 ATR capped at .3% of limit price; initial executable bid anchor
entry_slippage: A passive limit cannot execute above its limit; all hypothetical fills use that price, including favorable gaps. Published zero maker fee is not assumed.
fill_guard: Trade-through of limit by halfspread plus 5bp base/10bp stress, no target exit on the entry bar; stop always active.
stress: Double exit slippage, spread and trade-through guard; same fees and patient rule.
selection_rule: Training and calibration positive after all costs in base and stress; minimum 100 training and 20 calibration closes, no held missing bars or drawdown halt; choose highest stress calibration return, then fewer calibration fills.
reserved_gate: At least 100 closed trades, positive return and positive mean trade in base and stress; no held missing bars or drawdown halt.
limitations: Native archive OHLC does not prove queue position, order-book liquidity or a real limit fill.
Six declared development variants add selection bias; earlier market-order model failed.
Reserved month may overlap earlier project research; not claimed independently untouched.
No real broker orders or live fee eligibility assumed.
